title: add-log-prefix-to-logging
request: Can we add an optional log_prefix argument to setup_logging so that we can prepend a session ID or similar tag to every log message? It should be optional and default to None, and when provided the prefix should appear in the formatted output.

--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/ci/test_logging_prefix.py
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+import io
+import logging
+
+from browser_use.logging_config import setup_logging
+
+def test_log_prefix_is_present():
+    stream = io.StringIO()
+    # Force re-setup to ensure clean handlers
+    logger = setup_logging(stream=stream, log_level='debug', force_setup=True, log_prefix='SID123')
+    logger.debug('debug message')
+    # Ensure handlers have flushed output
+    for h in logger.handlers:
+        h.flush()
+    output = stream.getvalue()
+    assert '[SID123]' in output
+    assert 'debug message' in output
